name: The MasterMind 2
summary: The MasterMind 2 is a Martingale-based EA that opens trades based on a primary signal (typically a momentum or trend indicator) and doubles the lot size after each consecutive loss, aiming to recover all previous losses with a single winning trade. It operates without a hard stop-loss, relying instead on the Martingale progression and an optional take-profit target to close positions. The strategy inherently carries exponential risk as losing streaks rapidly escalate position sizes.
summary_zh: The MasterMind 2是一个基于马丁格尔策略的EA，在初始信号触发后开仓，每次亏损后将手数翻倍，试图通过一次盈利覆盖之前所有亏损。该EA不设硬性止损，依赖马丁格尔倍投和止盈目标来平仓，连续亏损会导致仓位呈指数级增长，风险极高。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是马丁格尔倍投法：首次开仓使用基础手数，当交易亏损时，下一次开仓手数翻倍，期望一次盈利即可回本并获利。入场条件通常基于简单的技术指标信号（如移动平均线交叉或RSI超买超卖），出场条件为止盈达到设定目标或账户权益触发保护机制。仓位管理采用固定倍数递增（通常为2倍），没有设定止损价格，仅依赖马丁格尔逻辑覆盖亏损。资金管理方面缺乏最大持仓限制和回撤保护，连续亏损可能导致手数迅速膨胀至爆仓。整体策略概念简单但在长期亏损序列下面临毁灭性风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is the Martingale doubling method: it opens the first position with a base lot size and doubles the lot on each subsequent entry after a loss, expecting a single win to recover all prior losses plus profit. Entry conditions are typically based on simple technical indicator signals such as moving average crossovers or RSI overbought/oversold levels, while exit conditions rely on reaching a preset take-profit target or an account equity protection trigger. Position sizing follows a fixed multiplier progression (usually 2x) with no hard stop-loss price set on any individual trade. Money management lacks maximum position limits and drawdown protection, meaning a prolonged losing streak can cause lot sizes to escalate exponentially toward account blowout. The overall strategy concept is straightforward but faces catastrophic risk under sustained losing sequences.
pros: 策略逻辑简单易懂，参数少，便于理解和调试
在短周期震荡行情中可能通过倍投快速回本并获利
设有最大订单数限制，一定程度上控制了极端风险
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and easy to understand with few parameters, facilitating debugging and configuration
In short-term ranging markets, the doubling approach may recover losses and generate profit quickly
Maximum order count limit provides some degree of protection against extreme escalation
cons: 马丁格尔倍投在连续亏损时手数指数增长，极易导致爆仓
没有设定止损价格，单笔交易亏损无上限
缺乏回撤保护和动态手数调整机制，资金管理薄弱
在趋势行情中逆势倍投会加速亏损
cons_en: Martingale lot doubling causes exponential position growth during consecutive losses, easily leading to account blowout
No stop-loss price is set, meaning individual trade losses have no ceiling
Lacks drawdown protection and dynamic lot adjustment, resulting in weak money management
Counter-trend doubling during trending markets accelerates losses
improvements: 增加硬性止损和最大回撤保护，防止单笔或累计亏损失控
改用固定比例仓位管理（如风险百分比）替代马丁格尔倍投，降低爆仓概率
improvements_en: Add hard stop-loss and maximum drawdown protection to prevent uncontrolled single-trade or cumulative losses
Replace Martingale doubling with fixed-fractional position sizing (e.g., risk percentage) to reduce blowout probability

risk_points: 马丁格尔倍投在连续亏损时手数指数增长，可能导致账户爆仓
没有硬性止损，单笔交易亏损无限制
缺乏回撤保护和强制平仓机制
risk_points_en: Martingale lot doubling causes exponential position growth during losing streaks, potentially leading to account blowout
No hard stop-loss means individual trade losses are unlimited
Lacks drawdown protection and forced liquidation mechanisms

It operates without a hard stop-loss, relying instead on the Martingale progression and an optional take-profit target to close positions. The strategy inherently carries exponential risk as losing streaks rapidly escalate position sizes.
